name: Yiri Qinglü
source:
The "Singles Day" is coming, and the student council will be hosting a "day couple" event. The boys and girls who signed up for the match will pretend to be a couple for the day.

The "couples" seem to have good first impressions when they meet, but it's only the start of a ridiculous day together.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.nvlmaker.net/tobestill/game1day.html]official site[/url]]
